title: Simulator hot pixel row check lets a hot pixel land one row below the frame
description:
The hot pixel loop of create_frame() in indigo_ccd_simulator.driver skips a pixel with 'y > frame_height' where 'y >= frame_height' is meant, so a hot pixel whose binned row equals the bottom edge of a sub-frame is written one row below the frame; the frame buffer is the unbinned size, so for most columns the write lands in its slack, but columns beyond 1439 of a full-width row reach past the buffer. Found by source audit next to the binning change, not reproduced; out of the binning task's scope. Next: change the comparison and add a sub-frame hot pixel case to test_ccd_simulator.

Imported from .factory/findings/archive/FND-20261027140318-5859-fix-simulator-binning-001.json (category: functional, blocking: no).
